text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: REDWOOD_CANARY_503_RATE_HIGH - service: inference-canary - env: staging - severity: critical

pagerduty: Incident created: INC-8521 - most recent trigger at 2799876542 - escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre

Oncall-Maya: acked INC-8521 :white_check_mark: - I'm on it, switching to incident channel. Anyone seeing customer impact?

SRE-Ash: seeing 503 spike from canary cohort after today's deploy (10:12 UTC). p50 okay but p99 error rate jumped to ~8%.

SRE-Ash: quick metrics snapshot:
```
canary-requests: 1200/min
canary-5xx: 90/min
5xx-rate: 7.5% -> baseline 0.2%
kvcache-miss-rate: 18% (up from 3%)
```

Eng-Leo: yikes. Which variant was rolled? Can you paste the deploy id?

SRE-Ash: roll id `deploy-2026-03-15-1220` - looks like quant-path V2 got promoted to canary (50rps). Logs show segfaults from quant-runner then 503 fallback.

Eng-Leo: copying logs from canary pod (tail):
```
[03-15T12:22:10Z] quant-runner: warning: unsupported kernel fallback
[03-15T12:22:11Z] quant-runner: error: invalid q8 kernel pointer (segv)
[03-15T12:22:11Z] svc-proxy: upstream error: 502 from inference-runtime
[03-15T12:22:12Z] lb-proxy: returning 503 to client
```

Oncall-Maya: probable root cause: quant kernel change in V2. We need immediate mitigation to stop customer-facing errors. Options: rollback canary -> global rollback or divert traffic away from canary. Thoughts?

Eng-Leo: prefer rollback for canary and block promotion. I'll prepare rollback. Who can trigger?

SRE-Ash: I can divert traffic from canary to stable while Leo prepares rollback. Running command to update routing fraction to 0% for canary.

SRE-Ash: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: traffic-split
data:
  canary-percent: "0"
EOF`

incident-bot: Routing update request received: canary -> 0% (applied by SRE-Ash) :gear:

pagerduty: INC-8521 escalated to eng-sre (level 2) due to continued 5xxs after mitigation at 2799876560

Support-Ryan: FYI support queue saw ~12 distinct customers with errors (mostly API 503) in the last 15 minutes. Logged IDs: 98432, 98433, 98435. Raising CS notice.

Support-Ryan: draft customer-facing note: "We're investigating increased 503s for short period after a canary deploy. If you saw errors, retry — we are rolling back the canary. We'll update when stable." Should I send?

PM-Lena: send now, please. Include apology and ETA of 15-30m. Also ask for any customer-reported request IDs.

Eng-Leo: rollback started: `deployctl rollback --service=inference-canary --to-tag=canary-v1`

deploy-bot: Rollback job `rb-2799876543-1` queued; pods terminating and recreating.

SRE-Ash: watching pod readiness... 3/3 stable pods back in 60s. p99 error rate dropping.

SRE-Ash: post-rollback metrics (60s window):
```
canary-requests: 1100/min
canary-5xx: 5/min
5xx-rate: 0.45% (down from 7.5%)
kvcache-miss-rate: 4%
```

Oncall-Maya: nice. PagerDuty: can we mark INC-8521 as mitigated and keep monitoring?

pagerduty: Status update: mitigated (actions: traffic-divert + rollback). Incident will stay open for postmortem until owner assigned.

PM-Lena: assigning postmortem to Eng-Leo + SRE-Ash. Please include timeline, root cause, and rollout gating changes.

Eng-Leo: will do. Initial RCA hypothesis: quant-path V2 introduced an unsupported kernel path on some machines -> segfault in quant-runner -> upstream 502 -> client 503. Need stronger canary checks (kernel compatibility probe + traffic ramp slower).

SRE-Ash: follow-ups: 1) add kprobe check to canary readiness 2) revert promotion pipeline to require 30m stable window 3) add automated auto-divert threshold at 2% 5xx. Creating tickets.

Support-Ryan: sent customer note and updated support thread, will escalate any high-priority customers directly to oncall.

Oncall-Maya: thanks all — I'll close incident channel in 10m if metrics stay stable. Great coordination. :clap:

PM-Lena: add postmortem meeting invite for tomorrow 11:00 UTC.

SRE-Ash: leaving a short runbook blurb in ops-docs about traffic-divert commands and rollback syntax.

Oncall-Maya: last check - p99 latency normal, error budget not significantly impacted. Closing loop.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8521 mitigation recorded. Close when postmortem uploaded.
